title: Close EventSource on async iterator return to prevent streaming freezes
author: Dylan Brooks
description: Fixes a resource leak in the browser streaming chat implementation: if a consumer stops iterating early (break/return) we were not closing the underlying EventSource connection. Over time, leaked EventSources led to stalls where onmessage stops firing (SUP-4922). Implement async iterator return() that closes EventSource, and add docs/examples to ensure consumers use try/finally when iterating.
commits: tests: validate EventSource closed on early break
